commands.review_summary:
Updates the Git-tag pin for @openclaw/design-system from v0.0.1 to v0.1.0 in package.json.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: package.json requests v0.1.0 while bun.lock still declares and resolves v0.0.1. A frozen-install check provides the focused runtime confirmation.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The blocking defect has a narrow mechanical repair: update the single stale lockfile resolution and rerun focused installation and build checks.
